items.title: The Nutcracker
items.summary: Make holiday magic unforgettable with The Nutcracker . Join us for a dazzling production of The Nutcracker , a beloved holiday ballet filled with wonder, imagination, and festive charm for audiences of all ages. Presented by Classical Arts Entertainment , this spectacular production showcases stunning hand-painted scenery, more than 200 exquisite costumes, and Tchaikovsky's timeless score, brought to life through cherished choreography.

items.title: Light Up The Port
items.summary: Kick off the holiday season at Light Up the Port, a festive evening filled with holiday magic, family fun, and waterfront charm in Port Credit. Watch as the Christmas tree and iconic Port Credit Lighthouse light up the night, marking the start of the holiday season. Enjoy free photos with Santa, holiday crafts, festive entertainment, carollers, holiday characters, complimentary seasonal treats, and fun giveaways throughout the evening.

items.title: Heart Comonos' 6th Annual Magical Holiday Season Celebration
items.summary: Looking to kick off the holiday season with a little community spirit? Join Heart Comonos' 6th Annual Holiday Gathering , a free outdoor celebration bringing neighbours together for an evening of music, culture, warmth, and connection.

items.title: Natalie G: Music Around The World 2
items.summary: Audiences are invited to embark on a musical journey around the world as a professional 12-piece band, led by singer and multi-instrumentalist Natalie G, performs songs representing more than 10 countries. From the vibrant rhythms of Latin America to the soulful sounds of the Mediterranean and beloved European classics, the performance celebrates cultural diversity through music.

items.title: Be Like Blippi Tour
items.summary: Join Blippi and Meekah for a live, interactive adventure that encourages kids to move, play, and discover just like Blippi. This exciting new production features high-energy music, engaging activities, and plenty of surprises along the way. Families will enjoy fan-favourite songs including "The Excavator Song," "Monster Truck," "Dino Dance," and "Curious Like Me," while singing, dancing, and learning together.

items.title: The Perfect Bite
items.summary: The Perfect Bite , presented by Secret City in collaboration with Netflix , brings its sold-out murder mystery dinner experience to Mississauga, inspired by the thrilling world of Netflix's Glass Onion: A Knives Out Mystery. Step into an exclusive culinary event hosted by acclaimed Chef Maribelle Moore , where a delicious four-course meal quickly becomes the scene of a gripping mystery . Interact with live actors, uncover secrets, and become part of the story as the evening unfolds around you.

items.title: Preserving Seasonal Food: Quick Pickling Workshop
items.summary: Learn the fast-pickle method to reduce food waste, boost flavor, and enjoy fresh-tasting produce!

items.title: Mississauga Festival of Trees: Holiday Market
items.summary: Discover the unique holiday treasures at the stunning Small Arms Inspection Building, with delightful Holiday Market! Featuring 80+ local artisan and culinary vendors, this market promises a festive experience for all.

items.title: Our Favorite Things — The Christmas Edit
items.summary: Our Favorite Things — The Christmas Edit , presented by The Craft Show, is coming to Meadowvale for a one-day holiday shopping event featuring a carefully curated collection of independent makers, artisans, food businesses and small brands. "Our Favorite Things" is thoughtfully curated to create an enjoyable Christmas shopping experience with variety across categories and fewer repetitive products.

items.title: Needle Felting: Fluffy Sheep Ornament
items.summary: Get into the winter holiday season and learn the art of needle felting, a magical craft where you transform soft wool into adorable, whimsical creations. Join fibre artist Cathy Disbrow as she shows you how to use special needles to turn wool into a sweet, fluffy sheep. Every participant will leave with a charming woolly keepsake ready to hang as an ornament or display on a tabletop. Materials are included in the price. You get 2 felting needles and wool. Foam felting pads are provided for participants to use during the workshop.
